MediaContentStandards.title: Media Content Standards
items: Respect the Divine Self, Islamic beliefs, monotheistic religions, and other beliefs, and not offend any of them.
Respect the system of government in the State, its symbols and institutions, and the higher interests of the State and society.
Respect the State's directions and policies at the internal and international levels.
Avoid addressing anything that may harm the State's foreign relations.
Respect the cultural and civilizational heritage and national identity of the United Arab Emirates.
Not publish or circulate any content that harms national unity and social cohesion.
Not stir up sectarian, regional, or tribal tensions, and not incite violence, hatred, or terrorist acts, or incite hatred and spread the spirit of discord in society.
Not offend the prevailing values in society and take into account the requirements of public interest.
Not offend the legal, economic, judicial, or security system of the United Arab Emirates.
Respect privacy rules and everything related to the private lives of individuals.
Not publish or circulate any content that may incite the commission of crimes or encourage murder, rape, or the abuse of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances.
Not publish, broadcast, or circulate expressions, images, drawings, or opinions that violate public morals, offend young people, or call for adopting or promoting destructive ideas.
Not publish, broadcast, or circulate false news, forged documents, or documents falsely attributed to entities or persons.
Not publish, broadcast, or circulate any content that may harm the national currency or the economic situation in the State.
Not publish rumors or misleading news.
Not glorify groups with destructive political, racial, economic, intellectual, or social orientations that oppose the United Arab Emirates or serve their own interests.
Choose appropriate persons when hosting them or accepting their participation in the media.
Advertising content must respect the culture, identity, and values of the United Arab Emirates.
Observe the age classification system for artistic works approved by the National Media Authority.
Respect children's rights in accordance with the legislation in force within the United Arab Emirates.
